results.note: Losing candidate Flávio Bolsonaro said on 25 Oct (about 22:40 BRT; CNN Brasil, Gazeta do Povo) that it is 'impossível reconhecer o resultado' and that he would seek annulment. In a 26 Oct video (Metrópoles 17:21 BRT) he again refused to recognise the result, and Folha do Acre quotes him as saying 'não fui eu que perdi, foi o sistema que ganhou' and seeking cassação of Lula's ticket. Only the PL (Valdemar Costa Neto, who does not count) recognised the TSE result; no recognition or congratulation by Flávio himself was found in the window. His own X/Instagram accounts were not checked directly.
ifo press release of 26 Oct 2026: Business Climate Index 90.2 points in October (September 89.9).
ifo release of 26 Oct prints October 90.2 vs September 89.9, strictly higher.
results.cik.bg was unreachable; News.bg and BNT (CIK preliminary, 99.94% of protocols) show Gyurov–Kandev at 31.94–31.95%, at least 28.00%; CIK final results are due 27 Oct.

toronto.ca/election-results was unreachable. CP24 reports Chow re-elected with about 54% and a 113,267-vote lead over Bradford at 87% of polls, a lead the remaining polls cannot overturn; the Globe and Mail and Global News headlines also report her re-elected. The final all-polls figure was not seen.

The four memoranda signed on 26 Oct covered a business council, civil protection, geology and cinematography, none on gas; ČTK (18:03) reports only a 'preliminary promise' from Tebboune to roughly double gas imports, with no gas document signed (vlada.gov.cz/aktualne unreachable).

After the 26 Oct three-party meeting, Praha TV (17:09) reports they discussed areas and the split of portfolios but reached no coalition agreement and will keep talking; ČTK's preview said the final portfolio split was still to be worked out with at least four points open.
ČTK (26 Oct 10:42) and kurzy.cz, quoting ČSÚ's 26 Oct release, give the October composite confidence indicator as 97.9, down 1.6 points m/m; the ČSÚ October page itself could not be fetched.
October is 97.9, down 1.6 points from September's 99.5 (the value on ČSÚ's September release page), so it did not rise; the ČSÚ October page itself could not be fetched.

ČTK (26 Oct 17:58) reports ODS, STAN, Naše Pardubice, Progresivní Pardubice and Noví lidovci signed the coalition agreement in the early evening of 26 Oct, and Pardubický deník confirms a Monday-evening signing at Café Gočár.

rik.parlament.gov.rs could not be fetched; RIK's preliminary results of 26 Oct evening (reported by the government portal and srpske.rs) give 'Ivica Dačić – Factor of Stability' 93,280 votes, 2.17%, below 3.00%, with no seats.

The Council's AGRIFISH meeting page lists the press release 'Baltic Sea: Council reaches agreement on fishing opportunities for 2027' dated 26/10/2026 ('The Council today reached a political agreement'), and Agence Europe also reports agreement on Monday 26 Oct.
